raw: I felt sad saying goodbye to my longtime upstairs neighbor when she was moving away. We had a final coffee together on the landing, with her moving boxes beside the stairwell. Those boxes are something I remember clearly. She’d been upstairs for so long, and there we were having coffee knowing it was the last time before she left. I was thinking about how strange it would feel not having her living above me anymore. I was glad we had that time together, but I didn’t want to say goodbye.
